draft_text: Varga & Sandoval (2021) suggest that salience pre-filtering may help reduce unsupported entities in summaries.
rationale: P1 describes the salience pre-filtering mechanism (scoring, threshold 0.35, training data) but contains no statement about unsupported entities or hallucination reduction. The attribution to Varga & Sandoval is unsupported by the cited passage. The exp1/cmp2 result (11.0 vs 15.1) is the authors' own re-implementation, not Varga & Sandoval's claim.
